Fixed2x2 pooling preserves only coarse final-feature arrangement; it does not recover earlier features, fine coordinates, geometry correctness, rotation invariance or guaranteed semantic preservation.
Roll512 is reported only as the V28 standalone source-validation population. It is not used to retrofit or re-evaluate older checkpoints.

This bounded audit uses saved scalar rows, saved execution metadata and server-side booleans extracted from executed source snapshots. It loads no model or checkpoint, weights, RGB, features or geometry and performs no forward, backward, update, old-GT reconstruction, preflight, test suite or target re-evaluation.

Population equality/provenance and checkpoint/RNG save mechanisms are metadata/source-code evidence. Checkpoint contents were not loaded; actual strict reload is the saved preflight witness, not a fresh reenactment.

RF100 scalar labels are offline derived from four annotated points. Historical GeoPRR comparison uses retained same-population scalar outputs; its executed pixels and complete weight chain were not recertified.
Training-loss checks cover saved finite aggregates only. Process time, full-process time, queue wall, preflight and reused source-generation history retain separate boundaries.

V27 has zero completed source epochs and no external outputs, so it is retained as a failed execution record rather than a performance baseline. All incompatible old models remain separate; there is no checkpoint ensemble or automatic promotion.
public_normalization: Full scalar metrics/CSV retained; complete population and fixed-cohort ID arrays, per-image delta maps, improved/regressed full-ID arrays and raw threshold/rescue/new ID lists excluded; paired counts, scalar group summaries and necessary focus/max IDs retained.
